name: EKODI Agentic Platform OS Control Model
principle: AI proposes and coordinates; policy authorizes; deterministic executors act; verifiers prove completion.

adminAxes.purpose: work, automation, deployments, finance and communication
people, organizations, customers, projects and files
health, security, AI, data, cost, connectors and infrastructure

A1.name: safe_act
A1.description: low-risk, reversible, idempotent action with evidence

A3.name: critical_act
A3.description: destructive, financial, identity, DNS, secret or irreversible action

invariants: core service remains usable without an external AI provider
AI never bypasses policy or capability checks
every mutating action creates an operation record before execution
completion requires evidence, not an agent assertion
production-impacting actions expose preview or diff when technically possible
high-risk and critical actions require deterministic approval gates
all executions are traceable by operation_id and trace_id
service-specific logic remains outside the admin shell
provider-specific details stay behind adapters or gateways
the five global admin axes remain stable
